body_lead: VIJAYAWADA: The State government has launched a pilot initiative to harness Artificial Intelligence (AI) in detecting diabetic retinopathy, a serious eye complication among diabetes patients. The programme, announced by Health Minister Y Satya Kumar Yadav, is being rolled out in government hospitals at Guntur, Kurnool, and Visakhapatnam. Under the scheme, fundus camera images of patients’ eyes will be analysed by AI systems to determine the severity of retinopathy and whether specialist consultation is required.
